spans.s:
Saindhava, ‘coming from the Indus,’ is a term applied to
water in the Taittirīya Saṃhitā,^1 to Guggulu in the Atharva-
veda,^2 to a horse in the Śatapatha, Brāhmaṇa,^3 and to salt in
the same text.^4
1) vii. 4, 13, 1.
2) xix. 38, 2.
3) xi. 5, 5, 12; Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upani-
ṣad, vi. 2, 13 (Mādhyaṃdina = vi. 1,
13 Kāṇva).
4) Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad, ii. 4, 12
(˚khilya); iv. 5, 13 (˚ghana).
